title: Historical due-date restitution and opportunity-cost ledger
epoch: 1931 book analysis; each ledger entry begins at independently documented due date
formula: sum over discrete dated nominal losses L_i*(1+r)^((as_of_date - due_date) in years)
rate_status: scenario parameter; not legal interest entitlement

cases.evidence_status: illustrative chronology only, do not fill nominal amount without payroll and comparator evidence
need applicant, loan terms and contemporaneous comparator
need individual eligibility and denied award records

book_check.causal_interpretation: book's asserted 27/73 causal decomposition is not identified by ratio comparison

controls: No adding $14.5T aggregate estimate to individual losses if overlapping
No combining inflation-adjusted 2024-dollar amounts with nominal compounded figures without rebasing
Do not conflate market opportunity returns with statutory prejudgment interest
Estate and generational succession require case-specific entitlement
Separate historical restitution principal from future AI dividends and UBI
Dated loss should compound once, not on both aggregate and underlying annual components
records: schema requires source_id, claimant_id_or_cohort, domain, original_due_date, principal_nominal_usd, base_dollar_year, chosen_rate, rate_basis, status, non_overlap_key, payments_received_usd, evidence_refs
